title: Rank parity and complex structures on the Kalton–Peck space
abstract: Develops symplectic Fredholm theory and the real Kalton–Peck space to prove rank parity of finite-rank perturbations and rule out a complex structure on a hyperplane.

informal.KaltonPeck.rankParityGeneral: The abstract symplectic Fredholm construction yields a rank-parity theorem.
informal.KaltonPeck.rankParityZ2: On the real Kalton–Peck space, T² + 1 has even rank whenever its rank is finite.
informal.KaltonPeck.noHyperplaneComplexStructure: A hyperplane of the real Kalton–Peck space cannot carry a complex structure.
